subject: Q1 goal endorsement and risk-mitigation plan
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Q1 goal endorsement and risk-mitigation plan

Team — attaching the consolidated Q1 packet for leadership sign-off. Key asks below: 

1) Endorse the OKR set (page 2-5) or call out items you want removed/tempered by EOD Friday (Dec 3).
2) Confirm the headcount and hiring ask on page 6 — we need final decision for budgeting.
3) Approve the risk mitigation table (tab: mitigation) or provide alternate mitigations; procurement & partner SLAs are the gating items.

Highlights: 
- Objective A: Reduce per-token inference cost by 18% across hosted + dedicated (KPI: $/1k tokens).
- Objective B: Shipping Redwood Optimize alpha to 3 customers (KPI: 3 active pilots).
- Objective C: Improve cross-region failover RTO to sub-800ms for 99th percentile requests.

Attachments: Q1_OKR_packet_v1.pdf, risk-mitigation-tab.xlsx
Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1Q1_OKR_packet_final
HubSpot: HS-Deal-121987

Notes on risks: partner integration timelines (ScaleWare) and an open HS legal ask that could delay onboarding for 2 pilot customers. I looped in ScaleWare Ops for visibility.

Next steps: if I don’t hear objections by EOD Friday, I’ll mark as approved and ask finance to commit the headcount funding.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Director, Product & GTM
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Q1 goal endorsement and risk-mitigation plan

Vanessa — thanks for pulling this together. Overall thumbs up. Two quick items: 

- Can you add a baseline for the per-token cost reduction? I want to see the current blended $/1k token by product (hosted vs dedicated) so we can justify the 18% target to finance.
- For the headcount ask: please separate product vs infra hires and include a 6-month ramp plan.

If you can drop an updated packet by Wednesday I can sign off earlier. Otherwise, assume my endorsement.

— Laura Bennett
VP, Customer Success & Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 12:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Q1 goal endorsement and risk-mitigation plan

Quick note from GTM: good priorities. Two requests: 

1) Sales targets underpinning Objective B — we need conversion assumptions for the three pilot customers. Add expected ARR per pilot (conservative/plan/aggressive).
2) Procurement/contract asks — can Legal and I get the list of outstanding contract terms for pilot customers? If ScaleWare SLA or data-flow terms require changes, that will affect timelines. 

Looping in ScaleWare Ops publicly so we get confirmation on integration ETA.

— Rishi Malhotra
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
From: ScaleWare Ops <ops@scaleware.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 13:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Q1 partner integration & SLAs (ScaleWare)

Vanessa / Vivek — thanks for the heads up and the packet. Quick confirmation from our side: 

- We can commit to a 99.9% availability SLA for the integration path outlined, with a standard exception for planned maintenance windows (we’ll provide a monthly maintenance calendar).
- End-to-end testing (sandbox -> stage -> prod) requires ~3 weeks after contract signature and access to the staging account (we’ll need API keys and a small dataset for performance tuning).

Attachment: deployment-sla-summary.pdf

Proposed timeline if contract signs by Dec 8: sandbox access Dec 9, end-to-end run Dec 10–28, pilot readiness Jan 5. If that fits, we’ll prepare the SOW.

— ScaleWare Ops
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Q1 goal endorsement and risk-mitigation plan

Thanks — this is in good shape. Conditional sign-off from me with two items to close before I file to finance: 

1) Baseline and split for per-token cost (Vanessa, please add host vs dedicated current $/1k and the precise levers we’ll use to get to 18%).
2) Final SOW from ScaleWare and a procurement checklist for pilot contracts (Legal/Procurement should confirm no unusual indemnities or data-residency clauses).

I’m okay with the hiring ask at a high-level; finance needs the split Laura requested and a 6-month ramp. Once the two items above are in the packet, I will approve and ask Finance to release the hiring approval to HR.

Quoted for context:

> Team — attaching the consolidated Q1 packet for leadership sign-off. Key asks below:
>

> 2) Confirm the headcount and hiring ask on page 6 — we need final decision for budgeting.
> 3) Approve the risk mitigation table (tab: mitigation) or provide alternate mitigations; procurement & partner SLAs are the gating items.

Attachments: Q1_OKR_packet_v1.pdf, risk-mitigation-tab.xlsx

I’ll wait for Vanessa to update by Wednesday, then we can close.

— Vivek Kulkarni
COO
